svg.aria-label: Barbell Drag Curl, Setup: Hold the bar at your thighs with your palms up.
svg.title: Barbell Drag Curl, Setup: Hold the bar at your thighs with your palms up.

svg.aria-label: Barbell Drag Curl, Drag up: Let your elbows move behind you as you draw the bar close to your body.
svg.title: Barbell Drag Curl, Drag up: Let your elbows move behind you as you draw the bar close to your body.

svg.aria-label: Barbell Drag Curl, Top: Keep the bar close and stop before your shoulders roll forward.
svg.title: Barbell Drag Curl, Top: Keep the bar close and stop before your shoulders roll forward.

svg.aria-label: Barbell Drag Curl, Lower: Lower along the same path and return your elbows to your sides.
svg.title: Barbell Drag Curl, Lower: Lower along the same path and return your elbows to your sides.
